name: Glasp Highlights Auto Export
description: Fetches new Glasp highlights on a schedule and formats them for export to any destination (Notion, Slack, Google Sheets, etc.).

setupSecrets.label: api.glasp.co API credential header value (for example "Bearer <key>"; rename the header if the API expects another one)

setup: Workflow secret GLASP_API_KEY: api.glasp.co API credential header value (for example "Bearer <key>"; rename the header if the API expects another one) for api.glasp.co (Authorization: <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.
After import, start the schedule: cdecli cron activate glasp-highlights-auto-export.

hints: "Glasp API" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.

notes:
## [Connect Your Destination Here]

Add your preferred export node after "Filter & Format".

**Available fields per item:**
- `title` -- Article/page title
- `url` -- Original URL
- `glasp_url` -- Glasp page URL
- `domain`, `category`, `tags`
- `highlightCount`
- `highlightsText` -- Plain text
- `highlightsMarkdown` -- Markdown
- `highlights[]` -- Array of objects
- `createdAt`, `updatedAt`

**Examples:**
- Notion: Create Database Item
- Slack: Send Message
- Google Sheets: Append Row
- Email: Send Email
- Webhook: HTTP Request POST

## [Setup - 2 steps]

**Step 1:** Get your Glasp Access Token
https://glasp.co/settings/access_token

**Step 2:** Create a "Header Auth" credential
- Name: Authorization
- Value: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN
Then assign it to the "Glasp API" node.

**Optional:** Adjust schedule frequency
by clicking the Schedule Trigger node.
Default: every 6 hours.

## [Security]

- Access token is stored in n8n's
  encrypted Credentials, never in
  the workflow JSON.
- Exported doc tracking auto-cleans
  after 30 days.
- No secrets in code.
